title: Restrictions on construction and projections on certain streets, parkways, boardwalks and beaches.
officialText: Notwithstanding the provisions of this chapter, it shall be unlawful to build, erect, or make areaways, steps or other encroachments or projections prohibited by Sections 19-131, 19-132, 19-135, 18-109, 18-112 and 18-113 of the Administrative Code.
